notes:
Summary: mid-market/enterprise retailer with large multi-vertical catalog (apparel, home, seasonal). Wants single stack for embeddings + rerank. Current stack: Elastic for retrieval + in-house Transformer reranker — cost and ops pain during promos.

Key metrics/asks (from buyer):
- Index size: ~7M active SKUs, + historical versions for personalization (~12M vectors).
- Query profile: 80% short queries, 15% faceted + semantic, 5% long product discovery sessions.
- Traffic shape: baseline 6k QPS/day, holiday spikes up to 60k QPS (10x) for search front-end; reranker invoked on top 40% of sessions.
- Latency SLOs: P95 < 120ms for retrieval+rerank path (they accept tail >200ms occasionally); prefer <70ms median.
- Cost target: cost-per-query (end-to-end) <= $0.002 for average search; willing to trade small latency increase for 30% cost reduction.
- Model preference: open to FP16 quantized LLMs for rerank (smaller fine-tuned reranker), prefer model variants that can fall back to lighter transformer / lexical hybrid.
- Routing/fallback: need automatic fallback to cheaper region/model during capacity strain; require predictable degradation not 500s.

Security/compliance notes: must support SSO (SAML), KMS for key material, audit logs + 13-month retention. Data residency: keep embeddings and logs in NA/EU depending on region. Legal flagged deletion/retention policy as a blocker.

POC notes: scope to include: ingest pipeline for product catalog + metadata, build embeddings (title + attributes + image-features stub), rerank integration with existing scoring signals (CTR, margin), simulate 10x holiday spike, produce tokenized/cost breakdown and cost-per-query model spreadsheet.

Quote from head of search: "We cannot afford a 5x bill during holiday — need a predictable unit cost and graceful degradation strategy."

Open items: confirm VPC peering requirements (security team), finalize data retention SLA, determine minimum committed capacity for Dedicated to hit cost target.
